name: stateful_ai-sample-personal-memory
description: Small LoCoMo-style multi-session personal-memory set: facts/preferences per user with queries whose gold answers are specific memory ids. Bundled so the IR benchmark is runnable out of the box; swap in real LoCoMo/LongMemEval JSON via the same schema.
